Add style and performance to your BMW S 1000 RR with our UltraGrip seat cover.

Specifically designed to provide maximum grip, durability, and style, perfect for riders looking for superior control. This seat cover is the ideal choice for those who love sporty riding and want maximum stability in all conditions.

⚠ WARNING: This seat cover is only compatible with the Standard OEM seat versions (810/830/850 mm). It is NOT suitable for the Sport M seat version.

Premium Materials for Performance and Durability

The seat cover is designed to offer the perfect combination of grip, durability, and a sporty, aggressive look, ensuring a more stable and secure ride in all conditions.

Tappezzeria Italia seat covers are made from high-quality marine-grade 100% PVC and printed with various textures such as carbon look, UltraGrip, Cordura, suede, leather, and more. Specifically designed for enhanced grip and style.

Available with or without logo. Contact customer support for custom logos or embroidery.

Customizable inserts, available in different colors to match your style:

  • 1BL (black)
  • 2WH (white)

Advanced Technical Features

✔ Waterproof* and weather-resistant, perfect for all seasons.
✔ UV Treatment to keep colors vibrant and prevent wear.
✔ Double reinforced stitching for greater durability and strength.
✔ High resistance to chemicals, such as gasoline, oils, and detergents.

✔ UltraGrip Technology: for extreme grip.

  • High-grip material
    The UltraGrip cover features a highly rough surface, specifically designed to minimize rider slippage on the seat. This is particularly useful during acceleration, braking, and cornering, ensuring a more stable and secure position on the bike.
  • Perfect for sporty and track riding
    Thanks to its high grip capability, UltraGrip is ideal for riders practicing sport riding, track days, or competitions, where bike control is essential.
  • Increased safety on the road
    Not just for the track! Even for road riding, UltraGrip offers significant advantages, especially in rainy or wet conditions, where extra seat friction can improve rider safety and stability.

Craftsmanship and Attention to Detail

Each seat cover is handcrafted by expert artisans, using advanced sewing techniques and high-quality materials. The artisanal production ensures a perfect fit and impeccable finish, with carefully crafted details for maximum performance and a 100% Made in Italy style.

Installation

Comes with a detailed installation manual for easy mounting. However, for optimal results and a perfect fit, we recommend professional installation.

Why Choose Our Seat Cover for BMW S 1000 RR?

✔ Enhances your bike's aesthetics with high-quality materials and an aggressive design.

✔ Extreme grip for sporty and secure riding.

✔ Provides protection and durability with waterproof and UV-resistant materials.
✔ Easy to install, with a detailed manual and professional mounting option.

You can further personalize and improve your riding comfort with other BMW Motorrad accessories for your S1000RR or M1000RR.

description: All the covers of Tappezzeria Italia, are made with 100% waterproof materials, the seams are heat-taped from the inside to prevent the infiltration of water,… Available in multiple sizes and/or colours — select your variant.
source_description_html:
All the covers of Tappezzeria Italia, are made with 100% waterproof materials, the seams are heat-taped from the inside to prevent the infiltration of water, ensuring 80% waterproofing.

However, infiltration may occur if the saddle is exposed to rain for a long time or to high pressure washing. These events, although rare, are not due to a defect in the coating.

All our saddles are made with a very elaborate graphic design, this in favor of an attractive aesthetic and great visual impact, our lines, now appreciated all over the world, are the maximum expression of made in Italy saddlery.

Master craftsmen sew our covers with great passion to give the customer a product that is recognizable and of great quality.

Unfortunately, the more numerous the seams in the coatings and the greater the possibility that small infiltrations will occur.

It is important to understand that if we realized covers with few seams (like some of our competitors) we could guarantee a total waterproofness of the saddle.

Anyway, Tappezzeria Italia put customer satisfaction first and so we decided to make small elastic and water-repellent covers that can be purchased separately from the saddle.

These protective covers (optional) are easy to adhere to the saddle and little bulky, if you find yourself having to leave the bike to the weather, just put the cover to be sure that your saddle will remain completely dry inside.

The protective covers will also be very useful both to protect your new saddle from water, and to protect it from the sun and from all those external factors that can ruin the saddle.

Each protective cover cost 20€ and can be purchased through our website or by sending an email to info@tappezzeriaitalia.it.

NOTE - THOSE ARE SEAT COVERS NOT THE WHOLE SEAT. YOU NEED TO PUT THOSE SEAT COVERS ON YOUR EXISTING SEATS.

description: All the covers of Tappezzeria Italia, are made with 100% waterproof materials, the seams are heat-taped from the inside to prevent the infiltration of water,… Available in multiple sizes and/or colours — select your variant.
source_description_html:
All the covers of Tappezzeria Italia, are made with 100% waterproof materials, the seams are heat-taped from the inside to prevent the infiltration of water, ensuring 80% waterproofing.

However, infiltration may occur if the saddle is exposed to rain for a long time or to high pressure washing. These events, although rare, are not due to a defect in the coating.

All our saddles are made with a very elaborate graphic design, this in favor of an attractive aesthetic and great visual impact, our lines, now appreciated all over the world, are the maximum expression of made in Italy saddlery.

Master craftsmen sew our covers with great passion to give the customer a product that is recognizable and of great quality.

Unfortunately, the more numerous the seams in the coatings and the greater the possibility that small infiltrations will occur.

It is important to understand that if we realized covers with few seams (like some of our competitors) we could guarantee a total waterproofness of the saddle.

Anyway, Tappezzeria Italia put customer satisfaction first and so we decided to make small elastic and water-repellent covers that can be purchased separately from the saddle.

These protective covers (optional) are easy to adhere to the saddle and little bulky, if you find yourself having to leave the bike to the weather, just put the cover to be sure that your saddle will remain completely dry inside.

The protective covers will also be very useful both to protect your new saddle from water, and to protect it from the sun and from all those external factors that can ruin the saddle.

Each protective cover cost 20€ and can be purchased through our website or by sending an email to info@tappezzeriaitalia.it.

NOTE - THOSE ARE SEAT COVERS NOT THE WHOLE SEAT. YOU NEED TO PUT THOSE SEAT COVERS ON YOUR EXISTING SEATS.

However, infiltration may occur if the saddle is exposed to rain for a long time or to high pressure washing. These events, although rare, are not due to a defect in the coating.

All our saddles are made with a very elaborate graphic design, this in favor of an attractive aesthetic and great visual impact, our lines, now appreciated all over the world, are the maximum expression of made in Italy saddlery.

Master craftsmen sew our covers with great passion to give the customer a product that is recognizable and of great quality.

Unfortunately, the more numerous the seams in the coatings and the greater the possibility that small infiltrations will occur.

It is important to understand that if we realized covers with few seams (like some of our competitors) we could guarantee a total waterproofness of the saddle.

Anyway, Tappezzeria Italia put customer satisfaction first and so we decided to make small elastic and water-repellent covers that can be purchased separately from the saddle.

These protective covers (optional) are easy to adhere to the saddle and little bulky, if you find yourself having to leave the bike to the weather, just put the cover to be sure that your saddle will remain completely dry inside.

The protective covers will also be very useful both to protect your new saddle from water, and to protect it from the sun and from all those external factors that can ruin the saddle.

Each protective cover cost 20€ and can be purchased through our website or by sending an email to info@tappezzeriaitalia.it.

NOTE - THOSE ARE SEAT COVERS NOT THE WHOLE SEAT. YOU NEED TO PUT THOSE SEAT COVERS ON YOUR EXISTING SEATS.

source_description_html:
All the covers of Tappezzeria Italia, are made with 100% waterproof materials, the seams are heat-taped from the inside to prevent the infiltration of water, ensuring 80% waterproofing.

However, infiltration may occur if the saddle is exposed to rain for a long time or to high pressure washing. These events, although rare, are not due to a defect in the coating.

All our saddles are made with a very elaborate graphic design, this in favor of an attractive aesthetic and great visual impact, our lines, now appreciated all over the world, are the maximum expression of made in Italy saddlery.

Master craftsmen sew our covers with great passion to give the customer a product that is recognizable and of great quality.

Unfortunately, the more numerous the seams in the coatings and the greater the possibility that small infiltrations will occur.

It is important to understand that if we realized covers with few seams (like some of our competitors) we could guarantee a total waterproofness of the saddle.

Anyway, Tappezzeria Italia put customer satisfaction first and so we decided to make small elastic and water-repellent covers that can be purchased separately from the saddle.

These protective covers (optional) are easy to adhere to the saddle and little bulky, if you find yourself having to leave the bike to the weather, just put the cover to be sure that your saddle will remain completely dry inside.

The protective covers will also be very useful both to protect your new saddle from water, and to protect it from the sun and from all those external factors that can ruin the saddle.

Each protective cover cost 20€ and can be purchased through our website or by sending an email to info@tappezzeriaitalia.it.

NOTE - THOSE ARE SEAT COVERS NOT THE WHOLE SEAT. YOU NEED TO PUT THOSE SEAT COVERS ON YOUR EXISTING SEATS.

All the covers of Tappezzeria Italia, are made with 100% waterproof materials, the seams are heat-taped from the inside to prevent the infiltration of water, ensuring 80% waterproofing.

However, infiltration may occur if the saddle is exposed to rain for a long time or to high pressure washing. These events, although rare, are not due to a defect in the coating.

Unfortunately, the more numerous the seams in the coatings and the greater the possibility that small infiltrations will occur.

The protective covers will also be very useful both to protect your new saddle from water, and to protect it from the sun and from all those external factors that can ruin the saddle.

Each protective cover cost 20€ and can be purchased through our website or by sending an email to info@tappezzeriaitalia.it.

description: All the covers of Tappezzeria Italia, are made with 100% waterproof materials, the seams are heat-taped from the inside to prevent the infiltration of water,… Available in multiple sizes and/or colours — select your variant.
source_description_html:
All the covers of Tappezzeria Italia, are made with 100% waterproof materials, the seams are heat-taped from the inside to prevent the infiltration of water, ensuring 80% waterproofing.

However, infiltration may occur if the saddle is exposed to rain for a long time or to high pressure washing. These events, although rare, are not due to a defect in the coating.

All our saddles are made with a very elaborate graphic design, this in favor of an attractive aesthetic and great visual impact, our lines, now appreciated all over the world, are the maximum expression of made in Italy saddlery.

Master craftsmen sew our covers with great passion to give the customer a product that is recognizable and of great quality.

Unfortunately, the more numerous the seams in the coatings and the greater the possibility that small infiltrations will occur.

It is important to understand that if we realized covers with few seams (like some of our competitors) we could guarantee a total waterproofness of the saddle.

Anyway, Tappezzeria Italia put customer satisfaction first and so we decided to make small elastic and water-repellent covers that can be purchased separately from the saddle.

These protective covers (optional) are easy to adhere to the saddle and little bulky, if you find yourself having to leave the bike to the weather, just put the cover to be sure that your saddle will remain completely dry inside.

The protective covers will also be very useful both to protect your new saddle from water, and to protect it from the sun and from all those external factors that can ruin the saddle.

Each protective cover cost 20€ and can be purchased through our website or by sending an email to info@tappezzeriaitalia.it.

NOTE - THOSE ARE SEAT COVERS NOT THE WHOLE SEAT. YOU NEED TO PUT THOSE SEAT COVERS ON YOUR EXISTING SEATS.

description: All the covers of Tappezzeria Italia, are made with 100% waterproof materials, the seams are heat-taped from the inside to prevent the infiltration of water,…
source_description_html:
All the covers of Tappezzeria Italia, are made with 100% waterproof materials, the seams are heat-taped from the inside to prevent the infiltration of water, ensuring 80% waterproofing.

However, infiltration may occur if the saddle is exposed to rain for a long time or to high pressure washing. These events, although rare, are not due to a defect in the coating.

All our saddles are made with a very elaborate graphic design, this in favor of an attractive aesthetic and great visual impact, our lines, now appreciated all over the world, are the maximum expression of made in Italy saddlery.

Master craftsmen sew our covers with great passion to give the customer a product that is recognizable and of great quality.

Unfortunately, the more numerous the seams in the coatings and the greater the possibility that small infiltrations will occur.

It is important to understand that if we realized covers with few seams (like some of our competitors) we could guarantee a total waterproofness of the saddle.

Anyway, Tappezzeria Italia put customer satisfaction first and so we decided to make small elastic and water-repellent covers that can be purchased separately from the saddle.

These protective covers (optional) are easy to adhere to the saddle and little bulky, if you find yourself having to leave the bike to the weather, just put the cover to be sure that your saddle will remain completely dry inside.

The protective covers will also be very useful both to protect your new saddle from water, and to protect it from the sun and from all those external factors that can ruin the saddle.

Each protective cover cost 20€ and can be purchased through our website or by sending an email to info@tappezzeriaitalia.it.

NOTE - THOSE ARE SEAT COVERS NOT THE WHOLE SEAT. YOU NEED TO PUT THOSE SEAT COVERS ON YOUR EXISTING SEATS.
